title: Young Woman in 1940s Fashion on Stone Steps, Snapshot, Sepia
description: A vintage sepia snapshot from the 1940s capturing a fashionable young woman seated casually on large stone steps. She is dressed in typical World War II-era casual attire, featuring a short-sleeved blouse, dark high-waisted trousers, folded ankle socks, and two-tone saddle shoes. Her hair is styled in classic victory rolls. An architectural spire and stone wall are visible in the background.
